scenarios.title: UC-00 · Normal Sinus Rhythm
scenarios.description: Maintain VVI standby pacing while observing intrinsic beats.
scenarios.objective: Confirm the pacemaker remains inhibited while the patient maintains an intrinsic sinus rate.
scenarios.feedback: No pacing spikes should be visible. If pacing occurs, lower the rate below the intrinsic rhythm or verify sensing leads.

rules.description: Loss of capture when rate exceeds the intrinsic rhythm without adequate output

effects.feedback: Increase the pacing output until capture returns, then add a 2 mA safety margin.

scenarios.title: UC-01 · Initial Setup for Bradycardia
scenarios.description: Stabilize a 35 bpm junctional rhythm by dialing in VVI pacing at 70 bpm with safe output.
scenarios.objective: Bring the patient to 70 bpm pacing with capture and a 2 mA safety margin.
scenarios.feedback: Increase the rate and then lower output to find threshold before adding safety margin.

rules.description: Patient stabilizes when the three knobs are within the target window.

effects.objective: Document the achieved settings and monitor for intrinsic beats.
effects.feedback: Great job – capture is reliable and the rate is on target.

rules.description: Oversensing occurs when sensitivity is set too low.

effects.feedback: The pacemaker is oversensing noise. Reduce sensitivity (higher mV) to resume pacing.
